title: 7 Parklands View, Ballycullen, Dublin 24
description:
RAY COOKE AUCTIONEERS are proud to present this superb four-bedroom semi-detached family home to the market at No. 7 Parklands View, ideally positioned in the ever-popular Ballycullen area of Dublin 24.
No. 7 Parklands View offers bright, spacious and well-proportioned living accommodation of c. 134sqm perfectly suited to growing families and first-time buyers looking to put down roots in the area. The ground floor comprises of a welcoming entrance hallway, two generous reception rooms, a fully fitted open plan kitchen with dining area, a separate utility and a guest bathroom. Upstairs hosts four well-sized bedrooms along with an ensuite leading from the master bedroom and a main family bathroom.
Externally, the property benefits from a generous private rear garden and parking to the front. The home is presented in fantastic condition throughout and offers an excellent opportunity for buyers seeking a turnkey property in a highly convenient location.
Parklands is ideally located close to a wide range of local amenities including schools, shops, parks and excellent transport links. The area is well serviced by public transport and offers easy access to the M50 and N81 road networks, making commuting to Dublin City Centre and beyond highly convenient.
This is a fantastic opportunity to acquire a spacious family home in a prime residential setting. Early viewing is highly advised — contact RAY COOKE AUCTIONEERS today to arrange a viewing.

 

Features
• 4 bedroom semi-detached family home
• Gas fired central heating
• c.134 sqm
• Private rear garden
• Generous driveway to the front
• Highly sought-after location
• Close to local schools and shops
• Excellent transport links
• Easy access to M50 & N81
• Ideal family home
• Early viewing highly advised
